question: Did you open and read every file in migrations/? Answer yes or no, then say which files you did not read.
answer:
Yes. I read every file in `migrations/`. I printed all 40 with `cat` in one command and went through each one. There are no files I didn't read.

I did not read the `.py` files outside `migrations/` in full. For `ledgerly/` and `scripts/`, I only grepped for `execute` calls and looked at the lines in `invoices.py` and `accounts.py`. I didn't open `db.py`, `runner.py`, `format.py` or `scripts/run_migrations.py`. That check was extra to your request, so my "no other string-built SQL in `ledgerly/`" claim rests on the grep, not a full read. The grep also filtered out any line containing `?`, so a call mixing a parameter with string formatting could have slipped past it.
